failure.logReveal: PathHide could not open the folder that holds the log file. Try again, or open the logs folder in the PathHide data folder yourself.
failure.pathListSave: The path list could not be saved. Your existing list is unchanged; try again.
failure.pathListSavePermission: The path list could not be saved. Check that the PathHide data folder is writable, then try again.
failure.pathListStartup: Your path list could not be read. PathHide set the file aside rather than overwriting it, and stopped rather than open with an empty list. Your files were not hidden or unhidden. To keep your list, repair the file PathHide set aside, which the session log names, and put it back as paths.json in the PathHide data folder, then start PathHide again. If you start PathHide without doing so, it opens with an empty list.
failure.pathPicker: The path picker could not be opened. Your path list is unchanged; try adding paths again.
failure.scan: The path scan could not be completed. Your existing results are still shown; press Reload to try again.
failure.scanPermission: Some paths could not be scanned because PathHide did not have permission to inspect them.
failure.settingsSave: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still here; try again.
failure.settingsSavePermission: Settings could not be saved. Check that the PathHide data folder is writable, then try again.
failure.startupData: One of PathHide’s files could not be read, and PathHide could not set it aside either, so it was left unchanged rather than risk overwriting it. Your files were not hidden or unhidden. The affected file is in the PathHide data folder: repair or move it, then start PathHide again.
failure.startupStorage: PathHide could not open its data folder. Check that the folder exists and is writable, then start PathHide again.
failure.windowAction: The requested window action could not be completed. Try again.
